preview.pickle.pickleProtocol.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: the pickle protocol, the number from 0 to 5 that says which version of Python's pickle format the file uses. The value is a number. The technical name pickle stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.pickles.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: how many separate pickle streams the app read in the file. A file can hold several. The value is a number. The technical name pickle stays as it is. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.pickles.ja: スキャンした pickle の数

preview.pickle.persistentIDs.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: the number of persistent IDs, which are references from the pickle to data kept outside it, such as the tensor data of a PyTorch checkpoint. The value is a number. ID stays as the abbreviation for identifier. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.storages.comment: Row label in the summary of a PyTorch checkpoint: the number of tensor storages, the blocks of numbers (model weights) saved in the checkpoint's ZIP archive. The app counts them from the archive's directory and never reads them. The value is a number. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.storageBytes.comment: Row label in the summary of a PyTorch checkpoint: the total size, in bytes, of all tensor storages (the saved model weights), taken from the archive's directory. The value is a number of bytes formatted by the app for the display locale. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.storageBytes.ja: テンソルストレージのバイト数

preview.pickle.checksumErrors.comment: Row label in the summary of a PyTorch checkpoint: how many pickle files inside the ZIP archive have a stored checksum that does not match their content. The app still read them. The value is a number. Shown only when it is above zero. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.checksumErrors.ja: チェックサムの不一致
preview.pickle.checksumErrors.ha: Checksum da ba su dace ba
preview.pickle.checksumErrors.es: Sumas de verificación que no coinciden

preview.pickle.imports.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: the list of imports, meaning the named Python functions and classes (written like module.name) that the file asks Python to fetch when it is loaded. The names in the list are shown exactly as stored and are never translated. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.count.comment: Column label inside the list of imports of a Python pickle: how many times the same import appears in the file. The value is a number formatted by the app for the display locale. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.kind.comment: Column label inside the list of imports of a Python pickle: the kind of the import, one of four groups the app puts it in (can run code, network or files, uncommon, expected for model data). The value is one of those group names. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.checked.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: what the app checked in the file. The value states that only the imports were read and that the file was never loaded. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.partial.comment: Row label in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: whether the app could read only part of the file, for example because it is large or because some parts could not be read. The value is Yes or No. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.kind.code.comment: Value of the Kind column in the list of imports of a Python pickle: this import is a Python function or class that can run commands or code (for example os.system or eval). A statement of what the import is, not a verdict about the file. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.pickle.kind.networkOrFiles.comment: Value of the Kind column in the list of imports of a Python pickle: this import is a Python function or class that uses the network or opens and changes files. A statement of what the import is, not a verdict about the file. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.kind.networkOrFiles.ja: ネットワークまたはファイル

preview.pickle.kind.uncommon.comment: Value of the Kind column in the list of imports of a Python pickle: this import is neither one of the usual helpers of model data nor one the app knows can run code or reach the network. Full models and scikit-learn files have many of these legitimately, so it is only information. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.kind.uncommon.ha: Ba na yau da kullum ba

preview.pickle.kind.expected.comment: Value of the Kind column in the list of imports of a Python pickle: this import is one of the ordinary helpers that a saved model's weights use (rebuilding a tensor, a storage class, an ordered dictionary). A statement about the import, not about the file as a whole. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.kind.expected.fr: Attendu pour des données de modèle
preview.pickle.kind.expected.ja: モデルデータでは想定内

preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.comment: Value of the Checked row in the summary of a Python pickle or PyTorch checkpoint: two short sentences saying that the app read only the list of imports and never loaded the file. It must not say or suggest that the file is safe. Loading means opening the file in Python, for example with torch.load. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.en: Imports only. The file was never loaded.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.tr: Yalnızca içe aktarmalar. Dosya hiç yüklenmedi.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.de: Nur Importe. Die Datei wurde nie geladen.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.fr: Importations uniquement. Le fichier n’a jamais été chargé.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.zh-Hans: 仅检查导入。文件从未被加载。
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.ja: インポートのみ。ファイルは一度も読み込まれていません。
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.hi: केवल इंपोर्ट। फ़ाइल कभी लोड नहीं की गई।
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.ku-Latn: Tenê import. Pel qet nehat barkirin.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.id: Hanya impor. Berkas tidak pernah dimuat.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.bn: শুধু ইমপোর্ট। ফাইলটি কখনও লোড করা হয়নি।
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.ha: Import kawai. Ba a taɓa ɗora fayil ɗin ba.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.pt: Somente importações. O arquivo nunca foi carregado.
preview.pickle.checked.importsOnly.es: Solo importaciones. El archivo nunca se cargó.
